title: Never push without asking
why: Pushing publishes work. A human decides when.

title: No destructive git commands
why: Force pushes, hard resets, forced cleans and branch deletes lose work that may not exist anywhere else.

title: Keep secrets out of the repo and out of the chat
why: Committed secrets leak through history even after they are deleted.

check.message: Private key committed to the repo

title: No recursive deletes outside the project
why: One typo away from an empty disk.

title: Ask before changing the guardrails
why: Red lines, flowrail settings and the Claude Code hooks are the human's to change. An agent that edits them has switched off its own seatbelt.

title: Ask before publishing a package or release
why: A published version cannot be taken back. Releases follow flowrail/workflows/release.md.

title: Never send email without sign-off
why: Email to a customer cannot be unsent. Drafts are fine; sending needs a human.

title: Never move money without a human
why: Refunds and charges reach real people's accounts. Support drafts the refund; a human issues it.

title: Ask before MCP tools send, invite, merge or delete
why: A calendar invite or a deleted record acts in the world. A human says yes first.

title: Never ship docs with draft markers
why: A draft note in a released doc reads as an unfinished product.

check.message: Draft marker left in the docs

title: Never change the sync wire format without a decision record
why: Old and new clients must keep talking. Write docs/decisions/NNNN-*.md first.
